channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Meta splits the WhatsApp Business Account into a WhatsApp Account plus per-provider Messaging Accounts
item.description: Meta is splitting the WhatsApp Business Account in two: the phone number lives under one WhatsApp Account, and each provider gets its own Messaging Account with its own templates and billing.

item.title: Meta ships specialized Muse models trained from Muse Wonder — 47% on its Personal Superintelligence Index, up from 38%
item.description: Meta shipped new specialized models for Muse trained from Muse Wonder, scoring 47% on its internal benchmark, up from 38%, with better memory and task recovery.
